page_title: LAZ 1-1 SAS | Lazio v Sassuolo 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Paride Tremolada has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Mattia Zaccagni is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Pedro (Lazio).
89' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
88' Substitution. Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Filippo Missori walks off.
88' Paride Tremolada shows a yellow card to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) for his blatant foul.

87' Great solo effort from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
86' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
85' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
83' Davide Ballardini has decided to make a change. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) replaces Samuele Mulattieri.
83' It will be a substitution. Uros Racic (Sassuolo) is ready to enter the pitch as Luca Lipani walks off.
82' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio).
82' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

81' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
80' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but Alessio Cragno punches the ball away.

78' Filippo Missori (Sassuolo) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
76' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
75' Davide Ballardini prepares a substitution. Josh Doig is replaced by Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo).
75' Substitution. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) replaces Cristian Volpato.
74' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
73' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luca Pellegrini walks off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
71' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Taty Castellanos will be replaced by Ciro Immobile (Lazio).
70' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paride Tremolada blows for a foul.
66' 1 - 1 Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and fires a superb strike into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
65' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
63' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for a foul.

60' 1 - 0 Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) displays what a brilliant free kick master he is, especially from this distance. He hits the ball very well and scores with a low shot inside the left post, leaving the keeper helpless.
60' Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
58' Filippo Missori (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' Paride Tremolada blows for a foul after Daichi Kamada (Lazio) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

56' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
53' Igor Tudor has decided to substitute Nicolo Rovella and he is replaced by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio).
53' We are about to witness a subsitution. Felipe Anderson (Lazio) for Matias Vecino.
53' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Paride Tremolada blows for a foul.
52' What a big chance! Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
50' The ball is cleared after Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' The second half gets underway.
45' The match has reached half-time.
44' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Ivan Provedel, who makes a comfortable save.
43' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
41' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
37' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
35' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

34' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
32' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Alessio Cragno (Sassuolo).

31' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Alessio Cragno makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lazio.
29' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle and it's Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' The ball possession at the moment is 62:38.
24' The game is interrupted as Adam Marusic (Lazio) is flagged offside.
24' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) sends a long ball forward to Luca Pellegrini, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
20' One of the players from Lazio times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
18' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

17' A sweet pass finds Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Ivan Provedel is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
15' The Sassuolo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
9' Paride Tremolada couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) and blew his whistle.
8' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
5' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo win a corner kick.
4' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lazio will have the kick-off.
Paride Tremolada will supervise the game today.
